status: synthetic mechanism experiment; not an ancient reconstruction or calibrated movement model
foodField: Synthetic annual cosine renewal, integrated over accounting intervals and planning horizons, identical phase everywhere and equal annual potential supply to constant control; accessible edible food per physical land area; not derived from climate or population density. Learned mode observes current stocks only at the resident patch. Memories project recovery and last-seen competitor demand, with confidence exp(-age/90 days); unvisited or stale information uses a half-capacity prior and no known competitors. Terrain, capacities and seasonal renewal remain known assumptions.

policies.food: Move if 14-day coverage <1, better provisioned terrain-connected destination within 30 km exists; include incoming group claims only in the perfect-information control; learned mode uses private observations and estimated destination budgets. Prefer fully covered budgets if available, then sample provisioned improvements proportional to coverage gain above the 0.1 threshold. Seeded behavioral assumption, not empirically fitted.
policies.scheduled: Original sampled move intervals and density/occupancy destination weights; same food accounting; under-provisioned journeys record deficits.

randomStreams: Movement seeded with seed; annual demography independently seeded with seed XOR 0xD3A09A in both comparison policies.
accounting: initial + replenished = environmental stock + carried + consumed + spoiled; deficits are unmet demand, not loss of food.
demography: Existing modern reference, intentionally unaffected by food deficits; equal between paired policies.
water: Unknown and not modeled; food provision feasibility does not establish water feasibility.
limits: Synthetic food inputs and local-knowledge assumption
No dated transient climate or regional phenology

viability.reason: No resource-condition or scarcity-demography response. Zero food still permits reference population growth.

forecast: Shared stock and potential renewal divided by total competing demand, plus private bag divided by focal-group demand. Proportional harvest forecast remains an approximation.

checks.scope: Synthetic food comparison; no empirical validation or adoption of rejected departure fit
